title: 대도시권광역교통위원회 직제 / queue:ADDENDUM:35013:20241126:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Presidential Decree on Partial Amendment of 12 Statutes and Regulations for Efficient Management of Government Personnel) <Presidential Decree No. 35013, November 26, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on December 31, 2024.

Articles 2 through 6
Omitted.

Article 7 (Transitional Measure concerning Amendment of the Organization of the Metropolitan Area Transport Commission)
Where, due to the reduction of one position (one Grade 8 position) in the personnel ceiling of the Metropolitan Area Transport Commission upon enforcement of this Decree, there is personnel in excess of the ceiling, a corresponding additional position shall be deemed to exist separately in the Commission until such excess personnel is reduced to match the ceiling under this Decree.

Articles 8 through 13
Omitted.
